task: Original selected action/sound top1 labels on real two-second Perception Test events
observer_training_events: All originally retained events per selected source, at most eight
fold_assignment: Rank in the registered source order modulo five; every event from one source stays together
generator_role: Original generator_train only, disjoint from all observer fitting
fresh_exclusions: All 1024 original allocations plus historical 112 and host calibration 16 IDs; duplicate known original byte hashes rejected
fresh_media_gate: All five training-source folds complete, selected models refitted/frozen, both source-uniform OOF accuracies >=0.60 and strictly above own fold-trained majority
normalization: Source-uniform training-fold mean/std, std floor 0.01, clamp [-8,8]; validation never fits normalization
selection: Maximum source-uniform OOF top1 accuracy; first registered candidate wins ties; no old development or calibration metrics
sampling: Uniform training source, then uniform retained event, with replacement

decoding.padding: Unavailable public context only; every target sample must be real

evaluation_media: Features computed from physically written/reopened RGB PNG, PCM16 WAV and FFV1 video; training target features cannot stand in for generated outputs
scope: New bounded observer diagnostic and source-separated generator mechanism. It does not replace original v3/v4 results, grant production authority, establish open-domain generation, or prove generated-output observer reliability.
